senses.gloss:
(Yuddha)jayārṇava
one of the sources used by Narapati ref. to by him a. the beginning of his Narapati Jayacaryā (Svarodaya); mentioned in Nirṇayasindhu an. by [Page200-b] Gadādhara in Pāraskaragṛhyasūtrabhāṣya, see Kane, HDS. I. p. 548a.

(Yūre)decayāmātya
son of Annayāmātya (C. 1500). of Kauṇḍinyagotra; disciple of Candramauli, a descendant of Prolanārādhya an. Lolla Lakṣmīdhara; a minister along with Nādiṇḍla Gopa an. Sālvasim3ha.
--C. Āmnāyastava of Daṇḍin. IO. 7050. Pt.. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 195b.
--C. Pañcikā on Malhaṇastava of Malhaṇa. IO. 7111.
--C. on Mahimnasstava of Puṣpadanta. Hz. 42. 315. MD. 11120.
--C. on Halāyudhastotra of Halāyudha. IO. 7195. MD. 11278.
